title: APCSV-2023-647-ZC-SPP-SPPA-HCA
text:
APCSV-2023-647-ZC-SPP-SPPA-HCA  Council District: 2 – Nazarian
  CEQA: ENV-2023-648-CE  Last Day to Act: 12-07-26
  Plan Area: North Hollywood – Valley Village

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed October 27, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  12243 West Riverside Drive

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  The proposed project is a Zone Change from [Q]RD1.5-1 to (T)RD1.5-1 for the purpose of removing the
  [Q] Qualified Classification. The [Q] Qualified Classification consists of conditions applied during an Interim
  Control Ordinance (Ordinance No. 164207) that reflected the draft Valley Village Specific Plan regulations
  and are no longer relevant since the site is now covered by the Valley Village Specific Plan. The project
  proposes a six lot small lot subdivision (considered under case VTT-83180-SL-HCA) that does not require
  the zone change to proceed as it is consistent with the Valley Village Specific Plan and the RD1.5 zone,
  and a Specific Plan Adjustment for a ten percent height increase to 33 feet in lieu of 30 feet.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15332, Class 32, an
  exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.4 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Zone Change
  from [Q] RD1.5-1 to (T)RD1.5-1;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.2 and the Valley Village Specific Plan, a Project
  Compliance to permit the construction of six small lot single family homes; and
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.4, a Project Adjustment to permit a ten percent height
  increase to 33 feet in lieu of the otherwise allowed 30 feet for single family dwellings.

  Applicant:  Yossef Aviv and Sigal Aviv
  Representative: Mark Stibleman, MS Development

  Staff:  Maren Gamboa, City Planner
  maren.gamboa@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1358
summary: Zone change at 12243 West Riverside Drive in Valley Village to drop outdated interim-ordinance conditions, plus approvals for six small-lot single-family homes and a height increase to 33 feet.
